name: Hina Love!
source:
The main character (♂), aka "big brother," is a second-year junior high student in the midst of puberty.

On this day, his neighbor, Mr. Hanamura, asked him to look after his house.

This is the first time in a while he's met with the Hanamura's daughter...Now, what shall he do?

[translated from [url=https://teagashiya.wixsite.com/tea-gashiya2/hinalove]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角（♂），又名“哥哥”，是一名正值青春期的初中二年级学生。

这一天，他的邻居花村先生请他看管他的房子。

这是他一段时间以来第一次见到花村家的女儿……现在，他该怎么办？

[翻译自[url=https://teagashiya.wixsite.com/tea-gashiya2/hinalove]官网[/url]]
